class.name: GiantJiggleChain
class.brief_description: One jiggling bone or bone chain, used by [GiantJiggle3D].
class.description: Starts at [member root_bone] and follows the first child bone for [member bone_count] bones. Each bone springs back toward its animated pose relative to its parent. All values are at human size; [GiantJiggle3D] keeps them correct at every size.

members.member: How many bones the chain has. Use 1 for a single jiggle bone and more for hair or tails.
How quickly the swing dies down. [code]0[/code] keeps bouncing, [code]1[/code] settles without overshoot.
How many times per second (at human size) the bone bounces. Lower is floppier.
Extra pull downward in m/s² at human size. Use about [code]9.8[/code] for hair and [code]0[/code] for jiggle that the animation already shapes.
The furthest the bone may swing away from its animated pose.
The name of the first bone in the chain.
Length of the last bone when it has no child bone. [code]0[/code] reuses the bone's own length.
